assumptions.claim: The external TL-UL host logic must correctly drive the tl_win_h2d[2] interface and correctly sample tl_win_d2h[2] according to the TL-UL protocol.
assumptions.risk: If the TL-UL signals are not driven/sampled properly, register window transactions may be lost or corrupted.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment describes a SHA3 core control sequence (start, process, get absorbed event, run, done) but no corresponding RTL exists in this chunk, implying that the state machine is implemented elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: If the control logic is missing or incorrectly connected, SHA3 operations may not execute as intended.

uncertain_points.claim: The TL-UL window interface arrays are hardcoded to size 2; if the design expects a different number of windows, this declaration would be insufficient.
uncertain_points.cond: when the number of windows requirement changes
uncertain_points.risk: Could lead to connection errors or data corruption if window count mismatches.
